meaning: n. 財團；聯營企業；協會

meaning: n. 皮帶扣環 v. 扣緊；（使）變形；彎曲

meaning: n. 聯邦；共同體；（the C-）大英國協

meaning: n. 口哨；哨子 v. 吹口哨

meaning: adj. 準確的；正確無誤的

meaning: adj. 優越的；較高的；上級的 n. 上級；長官

meaning: adj. 溫柔的；嫩的；疼痛的 v. 提出；投標

meaning: n. 失職；犯罪；不良行為

meaning: adj. 故意的；深思熟慮的 v. 深思熟慮；審議

meaning: n. 對手；反對者 adj. 對立的

meaning: n. 贊助者；主辦者 vt. 贊助；主辦

meaning: adj. 大量的；可觀的；堅固的；實質的

meaning: n. 例行公事；慣例 adj. 例行的；常規的

meaning: vt. 培養；滋養 n. 養育

meaning: adj. 輕微的；纖細的 vt./n. 輕視

meaning: adj. 遺傳的 n. 遺傳學

meaning: v. 漏；滲出；洩露 n. 漏洞；裂縫

meaning: n. 春天；彈簧；泉 v. 跳躍；湧現

meaning: adj. 苗條的；細長的；微薄的

meaning: n. 受訪者；回答者；被告

meaning: n. 一對；夫婦；幾個 v. 結合；連接

meaning: n. 潛水艇 adj. 海底的

meaning: adj. 商業的 n. 廣告

meaning: v. 摺疊；對摺 n. 摺痕

meaning: n. 混亂；困惑 vt. 弄亂；使困惑

meaning: v. 交換；兌換；交流 n. 交換；兌換

meaning: adj. 獨一無二的；獨特的

meaning: n. 淤泥 v. 淤塞

meaning: adj. 包括一切的；包容的

meaning: adj. 合理的；通情達理的；適度的

meaning: n. 緊急情況 adj. 應急的

meaning: v. 部分重疊；部分相同

meaning: v. 打擊；罷工 n. 罷工；打擊

meaning: adj. 模稜兩可的；含糊的

meaning: n. 爭論；爭端 v. 爭論；質疑

meaning: adj. 未察覺的；不知道的

meaning: n. 軟管 vt. 用軟管澆水

meaning: v. 巡航；乘船遊覽 n. 郵輪旅遊

meaning: adj. 難以置信的；驚人的

example: After a full day of digging, his shoulders were sore for two days. (挖了一整天之後，他的肩膀痠痛了兩天。)
Virtually all the flats in the new block have already been sold. (這棟新大樓的公寓幾乎全部都賣完了。)

meaning: adv. 有形地；可具體感受地

A stone from a lorry cracked his windscreen on the motorway yesterday. (昨天在高速公路上，一顆從卡車掉下的石頭砸裂了他的擋風玻璃。)

meaning: adj. 體面的；像樣的；正派的
example: After years of low pay, she finally found a decent job with regular hours. (在多年低薪之後，她終於找到一份工時正常、像樣的工作。)

meaning: adj. 沖積的 n. 沖積土
example: Alluvial soil near the river is rich enough to grow two crops a year. (河邊的沖積土壤肥沃，足以一年種兩次作物。)
The city cleared a large slum and moved the families into new flats nearby. (這座城市拆除了大片貧民窟，把住戶安置到附近的新公寓。)
Small factories distill local fruit into a strong drink sold across the region. (小型工廠把當地水果蒸餾成烈酒，銷往整個地區。)
A smaller car is far more economical for drivers who rarely carry passengers. (對很少載人的駕駛來說，較小的車子省油得多。)
Nobody knows the fate of the fishing boats that left during the storm. (沒有人知道在那場暴風雨中出海的漁船後來的命運。)
She must take her medication twice a day to keep her blood pressure steady. (她必須每天服用兩次藥物，以維持血壓穩定。)

meaning: n. 目標；靶子 vt. 以……為目標
example: The city failed to reach its target of cutting waste by a third. (這座城市未能達成廢棄物減量三分之一的目標。)

meaning: adj. 獨立的；自主的 n. 無黨派人士

The new clinic serves everyone living within a radius of thirty kilometres. (這間新診所服務半徑三十公里內的所有居民。)
The fossil was found by a walker who reported it to the local museum. (這塊化石是一位散步的民眾發現的，他向當地博物館通報。)

meaning: n. 陰涼處；色度；細微差別 vt. 遮蔽
example: Planting trees along this street provides shade and lowers summer temperatures considerably. (沿著這條街種樹能提供陰涼，並明顯降低夏季的溫度。)
The headmaster announced that the school would extend its library opening hours. (校長宣布學校將延長圖書館的開放時間。)
It is hard to wean drivers off their cars when buses run so rarely. (公車班次這麼少，很難讓駕駛人戒掉開車的習慣。)
The committee comprises eight members drawn from local businesses and residents' groups. (這個委員會由八名成員組成，來自當地企業與居民團體。)

meaning: adj. 穩定的；沉穩的 n. 馬廄
example: A stable income matters more than a high salary that may disappear suddenly. (穩定的收入，比一份可能突然消失的高薪更重要。)
Bookings for the summer season have been disappointing compared with last year. (與去年相比，今年夏季的訂房情況令人失望。)
Farmers in the delta grow rice on land that the river refreshes each year. (三角洲的農民在每年河水重新滋養的土地上種稻。)
Urban planners are trying to keep small workshops in the city centre. (都市規劃人員正努力讓小型工作坊留在市中心。)

meaning: n. 讚美；問候 vt. 讚美

Poor execution turned a sensible plan into a series of expensive mistakes. (執行不力，讓一項明智的計畫變成連串昂貴的錯誤。)
The old harbour is protected as heritage, so no new buildings may block the view. (這座舊港口被列為遺產保護，因此新大樓不得擋住景觀。)

meaning: adj. 適當的 vt. 挪用；撥款
example: It is not appropriate to discuss individual salaries during a company-wide meeting. (在全公司會議上討論個別員工的薪水並不適當。)

meaning: adj. 每年的 n. 年刊；一年生植物

The photographs depict life in the valley before the dam was built. (這些照片描繪了水壩興建之前，山谷裡的生活樣貌。)
Adult literacy classes are held in the evenings so that workers can attend. (成人識字班在晚上開課，讓上班族也能參加。)
Engineers calculated that the bridge could safely carry twice its current volume of traffic. (工程師計算出這座橋能安全承載目前兩倍的交通量。)

meaning: n. 奢華；奢侈品 adj. 奢華的

meaning: vt. 購買 n. 購買；購買的物品
example: The company purchased a fleet of electric vans to cut fuel costs. (這家公司購買了一支電動廂型車隊，以降低燃料成本。)

meaning: adj. 不斷的；持續的；忠實的 n. 常數

Seeds can remain in dormancy for years until the soil becomes wet enough. (種子可以休眠好幾年，直到土壤足夠濕潤才發芽。)

meaning: adj. 特定的；特殊的；詳細的 n. 細節
example: That particular bus route is used mainly by workers on early shifts. (那條特定的公車路線，主要是早班工作者在使用。)
A yearly subscription to the journal costs less than four issues bought separately. (這份期刊的年度訂閱費，比單獨買四期還便宜。)

meaning: n. 音高；場地；瀝青 v. 投擲；顛簸

This ticket entitles the holder to two free visits to the exhibition. (這張票券讓持有者可免費參觀展覽兩次。)

Durable boots matter more than fashionable ones for people who work outdoors. (對戶外工作者來說，耐用的靴子比時髦的更重要。)
Hospitals struggle to cope when several serious accidents happen on the same night. (同一晚發生好幾起重大事故時，醫院很難應付。)
The paper's circulation has fallen since readers moved to free news sites. (自從讀者轉向免費新聞網站後，這份報紙的發行量就下滑了。)
The tradition of sharing a large meal at harvest time survives in these villages. (在收成時共享一頓大餐的傳統，在這些村莊仍保存著。)

meaning: n. 益處；津貼 v. 有益於；受益
example: One clear benefit of the new rail link is shorter journeys to the airport. (這條新鐵路連結的一個明顯好處，是到機場的路程縮短了。)

meaning: v. 腐爛；衰敗 n. 腐爛；衰敗
example: Wooden posts decay quickly in this damp climate unless they are treated properly. (在這種潮濕的氣候下，木樁若不妥善處理就會很快腐爛。)
The map shows the uneven distribution of rainfall across the whole island. (這張地圖顯示全島降雨分佈不均的情形。)

meaning: n. 缺點；瑕疵 vi. 叛變

The statistics show that road deaths fall sharply once speed limits are enforced. (統計數據顯示，一旦嚴格執行速限，道路死亡人數就大幅下降。)

The engineers proposed building a tunnel instead of a bridge over the river. (工程師提議在河上建隧道，而不是橋樑。)

meaning: n. 裝飾品 vt. 裝飾

meaning: adj. 精力充沛的；積極的

Scientists measure atmospheric pressure to improve weather forecasts for farmers and pilots. (科學家測量大氣壓力，以改善提供給農民和機師的天氣預報。)

meaning: adj. 合作的 n. 合作社
example: Farmers formed a cooperative so they could sell their milk at better prices. (農民組成合作社，以便用更好的價格賣出牛奶。)
Salt spray will corrode metal railings along the coast within a few years. (沿海的金屬欄杆在幾年內就會被鹽霧腐蝕。)

meaning: n. 榮譽；尊敬 vt. 尊敬；信守
example: It was an honour for the whole village when the chef won a national prize. (這位主廚贏得全國獎項，對全村來說都是榮譽。)

meaning: prep. 除……外 vt. 將……除外

Working in a noisy environment for many years can damage hearing permanently. (在吵雜的環境中工作多年，可能造成永久的聽力損傷。)

meaning: n. 許可證；執照 vt. 批准

Sensors activate the street lights as soon as the daylight begins to fade. (天色一暗，感應器就會啟動路燈。)

meaning: adj. 主要的 n. 主修；專業 vi. 主修

The contract gives no specific date for completing the repairs to the roof. (這份合約沒有明確訂出屋頂修繕完工的日期。)

meaning: n. 目標 adj. 客觀的

meaning: v. 專注；集中；濃縮 n. 濃縮物

meaning: n. 衝突 vi. 衝突；牴觸

Hospitals keep an antidote ready for workers who handle dangerous industrial chemicals. (醫院為處理危險工業化學品的工人，備有解毒劑。)
Builders discovered an old well while digging the foundations for the new flats. (工人在為新公寓挖地基時，發現了一口古井。)
A longer report is not necessarily a better one, as readers soon lose interest. (較長的報告不一定就比較好，因為讀者很快就會失去興趣。)
Drought has affected almost every country on the continent during the past year. (過去一年，乾旱幾乎影響了這片大陸上的每個國家。)
Visitors can climb the turret of the castle for a view over the bay. (遊客可以爬上城堡的塔樓，眺望整個海灣。)

meaning: adj. 有彈性的；靈活的 n. 鬆緊帶
example: Farming incomes are elastic, rising quickly in good years and falling sharply in bad ones. (農業收入很有彈性，好年頭迅速上升，壞年頭則大幅下滑。)

A peaceful demonstration outside the town hall pressed for lower bus fares. (市政廳外一場和平示威，要求調降公車票價。)
Heavy snow interrupted power supplies to villages high in the mountains for three days. (大雪中斷了高山村莊的電力供應三天。)
When the plant closed, four hundred workers were made redundant within a month. (工廠關閉後，四百名員工在一個月內被裁員。)

meaning: vt. 處理不當；粗暴對待
example: The company mishandled complaints for months, so many customers took their business elsewhere. (這家公司處理申訴不當持續數月，因此許多客戶轉往別家消費。)

Doctors advise people with liver problems to avoid alcohol completely for a year. (醫師建議有肝臟問題的人，整整一年完全避免酒精。)
The suppression of the protests badly damaged the government's reputation with foreign investors. (對抗議的鎮壓，嚴重損害了政府在外國投資人心中的聲譽。)
The town's income comes mainly from tourism and from fishing in summer. (這個小鎮的收入主要來自觀光，以及夏季的漁業。)
Property prices near the new station have risen much faster than local wages. (新車站附近的房地產價格，漲幅遠超過當地薪資。)
The hill offers a naked view of the bay, with nothing to block the wind. (這座山丘毫無遮蔽，可以望見整個海灣，也沒有東西擋風。)

meaning: n. 特徵；面貌；專題報導 v. 以……為特色

The event coordinator found a larger hall after ticket sales doubled in a week. (售票在一週內成長一倍後，活動協調者找到了更大的場地。)
A diet of fish and vegetables nourishes the body better than fried snacks. (魚和蔬菜的飲食，比油炸零食更能滋養身體。)

meaning: adj. 脆的；俐落的 n. 洋芋片
example: The bread stays crisp for a day if it is kept in a paper bag. (麵包放在紙袋裡，可以保持酥脆一整天。)
He felt guilty about leaving the team just before the busiest month. (他在最忙的月份前離開團隊，為此感到內疚。)

meaning: n. 裂縫；爆裂聲 v. 破裂；崩潰
example: A crack in the dam wall was noticed by a worker during a routine check. (水壩牆面的一道裂縫，被一名工人在例行檢查時發現。)

meaning: v. 繁榮；興旺；茁壯成長
example: Small restaurants flourish in this district once the offices close for the day. (這一區的小餐館，在辦公室下班後就開始興旺起來。)

meaning: vt. 預訂；保留 n. 儲備；保護區
example: It is wise to reserve a table at that popular restaurant several days ahead. (那家熱門餐廳最好提前幾天預訂桌位。)
Designers now produce three-dimensional models before any part of the engine is manufactured. (現在設計師會先做出立體模型，才會開始製造引擎的任何零件。)
Workers spread gravel along the path so that it stays dry in winter. (工人在步道上鋪礫石，讓它在冬天保持乾燥。)
The advertisement promised free delivery, but the small print at the bottom said otherwise. (廣告承諾免運費，但最下面的細則寫的卻不是這樣。)
Better insulation in the roof cut the family's heating bill by nearly half. (屋頂隔熱改善之後，這家人的暖氣費少了將近一半。)

Repeated delays have gradually undermined public trust in the new rail company. (一再誤點逐漸削弱了民眾對這家新鐵路公司的信任。)
The new filters eliminate almost all dust from the air inside the factory. (新的濾網幾乎消除了工廠內部空氣中所有的粉塵。)
The volcano has been quiet for a century, but scientists still monitor it closely. (這座火山已沉寂一個世紀，但科學家仍密切監測。)
The price excludes meals, which the hotel charges separately at the end. (這個價格不含餐點，飯店會在最後另外收費。)
The hotel sends its laundry to a service two streets away every morning. (這家飯店每天早上把待洗衣物送到兩條街外的洗衣公司。)
The road is apparently closed for repairs, so we must take a longer route. (這條路似乎因維修而封閉，所以我們得走更遠的路。)

Lower taxes on small firms are meant to stimulate hiring in the region. (降低小企業的稅負，是為了刺激這個地區的僱用意願。)

meaning: n. 燃料 v. 加燃料；助長

The new water plant will be fully operational by the end of next month. (新的自來水廠將在下個月底全面運作。)
The airline spent millions trying to repair its image after the delays. (在連串誤點之後，這家航空公司花了數百萬試圖挽救形象。)
Volunteers distributed blankets and drinking water to families in the flooded area. (志工分發毛毯和飲用水給淹水地區的家庭。)
The notice board by the lift lists which flats have parcels waiting downstairs. (電梯旁的佈告欄列出哪些住戶有包裹在樓下待領。)
The council intends to ban cars from the square during the summer months. (市議會打算在夏季期間禁止車輛進入廣場。)

meaning: adj. 經驗主義的；實證的
example: There is little empirical evidence that longer working hours actually raise output. (很少有實證證據顯示，延長工時真能提高產出。)
New staff spend six months on probation before they receive a permanent contract. (新進員工有六個月試用期，之後才拿到正式合約。)

meaning: n. 憂鬱；不景氣；低氣壓
example: The depression of the 1930s forced many families to leave the countryside. (1930 年代的經濟不景氣，迫使許多家庭離開鄉村。)
The proximity of the airport makes this neighbourhood popular with business travellers. (由於鄰近機場，這個社區很受商務旅客歡迎。)
The leaking roof attracted little attention until the rain reached the offices. (屋頂漏水一直沒受到太多關注，直到雨水滲進辦公室。)
A factual account of the accident helped the insurers settle the claim quickly. (一份根據事實的意外說明，幫助保險公司迅速理賠。)

meaning: vt. 讚揚；歡呼 n. 讚譽

The typhoon devastated the fishing village, destroying boats and most of the roofs. (颱風摧毀了這座漁村，船隻和大部分屋頂都被破壞。)
The response to the free health checks was far stronger than expected. (免費健康檢查的反應遠比預期熱烈。)
Please write your postcode clearly so the parcel reaches the right office. (請把郵遞區號寫清楚，包裹才能送到正確的辦公室。)
The documentary was dull, even though the subject itself is genuinely fascinating. (這部紀錄片很乏味，儘管主題本身其實很有意思。)
Wages are reviewed on a yearly basis, usually after the main harvest. (薪資每年檢討一次，通常是在主要收成之後。)
Tropical storms often shut down flights to the islands for several days. (熱帶風暴經常讓飛往這些島嶼的航班停飛好幾天。)
Rumours about job cuts spread through the factory long before any announcement. (早在正式宣布之前，裁員的謠言就在工廠裡傳開。)
Despite every endeavour to save it, the old cinema closed last winter. (儘管費盡努力挽救，這座老電影院仍在去年冬天歇業。)

meaning: n. 地址；演說 vt. 處理；向……講話

The view from the ridge was superb, though the climb took three tiring hours. (山稜上的景色極好，雖然爬上來花了累人的三小時。)

The trial demonstrates that cheaper drugs can be just as effective for most patients. (這項試驗證明，較便宜的藥物對大多數病患同樣有效。)
Housing was at the top of the agenda at yesterday's council meeting. (在昨天的市議會會議上，住宅問題是議程的首要項目。)
New lamps illuminate the riverside path so people can walk home safely. (新路燈照亮了河邊的步道，讓大家能安全走路回家。)

meaning: adj. 苗條的；薄的 vi. 變苗條
example: She stays slim by cycling to work instead of taking the bus. (她靠騎自行車上班而不搭公車，保持身材苗條。)

meaning: v. 保證；使……有正當理由 n. 授權；許可證

meaning: n. 等級；軍銜 v. 排列；評定等級

meaning: v. 有助於；有用 n. 效用

meaning: n. 街區；障礙物 vt. 阻塞；封鎖

meaning: adj. 抵抗的；有抵抗力的

The jury took two days to reach a verdict in the fraud case. (陪審團花了兩天，才在詐欺案中做出判決。)
Nurses returning to work after a long break attend a refresher course first. (長期休息後重返工作崗位的護理師，必須先上複習課程。)

meaning: v. 熊熊燃燒 n. 火焰
example: The fire blazed for six hours before crews brought it under control. (大火燒了六個小時，消防人員才控制住。)
Investors misjudged the demand for electric bikes and lost a great deal. (投資人誤判電動自行車的需求，損失慘重。)
Pregnant workers are entitled to extra breaks and to changes in their working hours. (懷孕的員工有權獲得額外休息時間，並調整工作時數。)

meaning: adj. 頑強的；堅硬的；不屈的
example: The union remained unyielding throughout the talks, so no agreement was reached. (工會在整場談判中態度頑強，因此沒有達成協議。)

meaning: adj. 外部的 n. 外部；外表

A client asked us to finish the report a week earlier than agreed. (一位客戶要求我們比原先約定提前一週完成報告。)

meaning: n. 方言；本地話 adj. 方言的

meaning: n. 卡式錄音帶；卡式錄影帶

meaning: adj. 急性的；敏銳的；劇烈的

meaning: vt. 審查 n. 獸醫

Fog crept in from the sea and covered the whole harbour by midnight. (海霧悄悄飄進來，到午夜時已覆蓋整個港口。)

meaning: adj. 偶然的；臨時的；非正式的

meaning: n. 狀況；條件 vt. 使習慣；影響

The new breakwater helped stabilise the beach and protect the houses nearby. (新的防波堤協助穩定了海灘，並保護附近的房屋。)

meaning: adj. 進來的；新任的 n. 收入

The taxi driver put our bags in the boot and drove us to the hotel. (計程車司機把我們的行李放進車後行李箱，載我們到飯店。)
Banning certain chemicals helped the ozone layer begin to recover quite slowly. (禁用某些化學物質後，臭氧層開始相當緩慢地復原。)

meaning: n. 酸 adj. 酸的；尖刻的
example: Rain containing weak acid has damaged the stonework of many old churches. (含弱酸的雨水，損害了許多老教堂的石造部分。)

meaning: adj. 快速發展的；激增的
example: The booming tourist trade has pushed rents up for people who live here. (快速發展的觀光業，推高了當地居民的租金。)
We need a definite answer by Friday, or the order will be cancelled. (我們週五前需要明確的答覆，否則訂單將被取消。)
The building was deemed unsafe, so tenants were moved to temporary flats. (這棟大樓被認為不安全，因此房客被安置到臨時公寓。)

meaning: n. 輔導課；指南 adj. 輔導的

meaning: n. 雪橇 vi. 乘雪橇

The new restriction on water use applies to gardens as well as cars. (新的用水限制，對花園和洗車都同樣適用。)
The builders abandoned the whole project when the funding was suddenly withdrawn. (資金突然被撤回後，建商放棄了整項計畫。)
Repairing the leak is the top priority before the wet season starts. (在雨季開始前，修好漏水是最優先的事。)
The sudden shaking of the building terrified everyone on the top floor. (大樓突然搖晃，讓頂樓所有人都嚇壞了。)
Draining the marsh destroyed the habitat of several rare birds and insects. (抽乾沼澤，破壞了好幾種稀有鳥類和昆蟲的棲息地。)
Cheaper season tickets encourage more people to leave their cars at home. (較便宜的月票能促使更多人把車留在家裡。)
A celebrity chef opened a small restaurant in the village, and bookings doubled. (一位名人主廚在村裡開了小餐館，訂位量就增加了一倍。)
The discovery is of great significance for treating this rare illness earlier. (這項發現對於更早治療這種罕見疾病意義重大。)

meaning: adj. 磁性的；有吸引力的

The witness gave a graphic account of the flood that swept through the village. (那位證人生動描述了沖過村莊的那場洪水。)
Engineers examined the bridge closely after reports of movement during strong winds. (在傳出強風中橋身晃動的消息後，工程師仔細檢查了這座橋。)
The harbour expansion gave local firms an opportunity to win overseas contracts. (港口擴建讓本地企業有機會贏得海外合約。)
It is hard to distinguish the two brands, since both use similar packaging. (這兩個品牌很難區別，因為兩者包裝很相似。)
Staff handed out blankets and soup to families waiting in the cold. (工作人員發放毯子和熱湯，給在寒風中等待的家庭。)

The era of cheap flights may be ending as fuel costs keep rising. (隨著燃料成本持續上漲，廉價航空的時代可能正在結束。)
Lower interest rates acted as a stimulus for small businesses to borrow. (較低的利率成為小企業借貸的促進因素。)
Deer roam freely through the woods and often damage the young trees. (鹿在樹林裡自由漫遊，常破壞幼樹。)
The trip will go ahead provided that the ferry service resumes tomorrow. (只要渡輪明天復駛，這趟行程就會照常出發。)

meaning: n. 建築學；建築風格；架構

meaning: n. 障礙；跨欄 v. 跨越

meaning: adj. 潮溼的 n. 溼氣 vt. 使潮溼；抑制

meaning: n. 全體員工 vt. 配備人員

meaning: adj. 易於……的；適切的；敏捷的

meaning: n. 梯田；陽臺；露天平臺
example: We had breakfast on the terrace while looking out over the harbour. (我們在陽臺上吃早餐，同時眺望海港的景色。)

meaning: adj. 動力的；充滿活力的

meaning: prep. 遍及；貫穿整個…… adv. 各處；自始至終

Local residents criticised the council for approving the tower without public consultation. (當地居民批評市議會未經公眾諮詢就批准這座高樓。)
The cost of the repairs went far beyond what the owners had budgeted for. (維修費用遠遠超出屋主原本編列的預算。)
Farmers in the hinterland send their produce to the port by lorry every day. (內地的農民每天用卡車把農產品送到港口。)

meaning: adj. 肯定的；積極的；明確的

meaning: adj. 助理的 n. 助理；助手

An old cannon still stands on the wall where the town once defended itself. (一門舊大炮仍矗立在城牆上，那裡曾是這座城鎮防衛自己的地方。)
Employers have an obligation to provide safe equipment for everyone on site. (雇主有義務為工地上的每個人提供安全的設備。)
The local hockey club trains twice a week and plays matches on Sundays. (當地的曲棍球俱樂部每週訓練兩次，週日比賽。)
Workers fought for the liberty to organise unions without fear of losing their jobs. (勞工爭取組織工會的自由，而不必擔心失去工作。)
Using less pesticide has helped bees and other insects return to the orchard. (減少使用農藥，讓蜜蜂和其他昆蟲回到果園。)

meaning: n. 民意調查；投票 v. 調查；獲得選票

meaning: n. 洞察力；深刻的理解
example: Talking to long-term residents gave the planners real insight into local needs. (與長期居民交談，讓規劃人員真正了解當地的需求。)
Villagers resisted the plan to dam the river and won support from lawyers. (村民抵抗在河上築壩的計畫，並獲得律師的支持。)

meaning: vi. 滑行；滑翔 n. 滑行

meaning: n. 傷亡人員；傷亡事故
example: The new safety rules have reduced the number of casualties on building sites. (新的安全規定降低了建築工地的傷亡人數。)
A strong belief in local produce drew customers to her small shop. (對本地農產品的堅定信念，為她的小店帶來顧客。)
High concentrations of salt in the soil prevent most crops from growing well. (土壤中高濃度的鹽分，讓大部分作物無法好好生長。)
Two workers tugged hard on the rope until the boat touched the shore. (兩名工人用力拉著繩索，直到船靠上岸。)
The hearing will proceed once all the missing documents have been found. (等所有失蹤的文件找到之後，聽審就會繼續進行。)
The status of the building project changes every week as funding is reviewed. (隨著資金不斷檢討，這項建築計畫的狀況每週都在變。)

meaning: n. 文件；證件 vt. 記錄
example: Keep every document related to the sale in case of a dispute later. (把與這筆交易相關的每份文件都留好，以防日後有爭議。)
The old mattress was replaced because it had begun to hurt his back. (舊床墊因為開始讓他背痛，所以被換掉了。)
The staff were hostile at first, but they warmed up after a few weeks. (員工起初不太友善，但幾週後態度就緩和了。)
The government had to intervene in the market when the price of bread doubled. (當麵包價格翻倍時，政府不得不介入市場。)
He was promoted to supervisor after three years on the night shift. (他在夜班待了三年之後被升為主管。)

meaning: v. 碰撞；顛簸前進 n. 碰撞；隆起
example: The delivery van bumped against the gate, but nothing inside was damaged. (送貨廂型車撞到鐵門，但裡面的東西都沒損壞。)
A reunion of former miners is held in the village hall each September. (每年九月，前礦工的重聚會在村莊活動中心舉行。)
Slow, regular meals are better for the digestive system than eating late. (細嚼慢嚥、定時用餐，比晚間進食更有利於消化系統。)
Staying with a homestay family helped him learn the language far faster. (住在寄宿家庭裡，讓他的語言學習快得多。)
The firm has committed itself to finishing the road before the rains come. (這家公司已承諾在雨季來臨前完成這條道路。)
Practically every household in the valley now has electricity and a phone line. (山谷裡幾乎每一戶人家現在都有電力和電話線。)

meaning: n. 雜技演員；特技演員
example: The acrobat balanced on a narrow pole while the crowd held its breath. (雜技演員在窄桿上保持平衡，觀眾都屏住呼吸。)
Ticket revenue from the museum pays for most of the restoration work. (博物館的門票收入，支付了大部分的修復工作。)
Nickel is used in batteries, which makes its price important for carmakers. (鎳用於電池，這使得它的價格對車廠很重要。)

meaning: adj. 軟的；無力的 vi. 跛行
example: The lettuce looked limp after a day in the warm delivery van. (萵苣在溫暖的送貨車裡放了一天之後，看起來就軟掉了。)

meaning: v. 吐（唾沫）；噴出 n. 唾液
example: The old engine spits out a cloud of smoke whenever it starts. (這台老引擎每次發動都會噴出一團煙。)
Auditors found an irregularity in the accounts and reported it to the board. (查帳人員發現帳目有一處不合規的地方，並向董事會報告。)
A cool breeze from the sea makes the evening market pleasant to walk through. (一陣涼爽的海風，讓傍晚的市場走起來很舒服。)
Volunteering abroad is one avenue to gain experience before a career change. (到國外當志工，是轉行前累積經驗的一條途徑。)
Cheap lenses magnify the image but often blur the edges of the picture. (便宜的鏡頭會放大影像，但常讓畫面邊緣模糊。)

meaning: n. 蜂巢；蜂箱；繁忙之處
example: Beekeepers move their hives to the orchard when the fruit trees blossom. (果樹開花時，養蜂人把蜂箱移到果園裡。)
Engineers added a thin layer of oxide to stop the metal from rusting. (工程師加上一層薄薄的氧化物，防止金屬生鏽。)
A calf born in the spring needs milk and shelter for several months. (春天出生的小牛，需要喝奶並有遮蔽處好幾個月。)
Safety is the foremost concern when crews work on high-voltage power lines. (工作人員在高壓電線上作業時，安全是最重要的考量。)
The procedure for reporting an accident is posted on the wall of every workshop. (意外通報的程序，張貼在每間工作坊的牆上。)
Workers assemble the frames by hand, which is why each chair costs so much. (工人以手工組裝骨架，這也是每張椅子價格這麼高的原因。)
Universities treat plagiarism seriously, and repeated offences can lead to permanent expulsion. (大學對抄襲相當重視，累犯可能導致退學。)
The horse galloped across the field as soon as the gate was opened. (閘門一打開，馬就在田野上奔馳起來。)

meaning: v. 保證；發誓 n. 誓言；保證
example: Wealthy countries pledged more money to help farmers recover from the drought. (富裕國家承諾提供更多資金，協助農民從乾旱中復原。)
Hand washing remains the most effective way to stop the spread of infections. (洗手仍是阻止傳染病散播最有效的方法。)
Passengers appreciate the extra space on the new trains during the morning rush. (乘客很感謝新列車在早晨尖峰時提供更多空間。)
The manager firmly denied that the company had ignored the safety warnings. (經理堅決否認公司曾忽視安全警告。)
The union negotiated a pay rise of four per cent for its members. (工會為會員爭取到百分之四的加薪。)
Looking after elderly parents is a responsibility many families share with relatives. (照顧年邁的父母，是許多家庭與親戚共同分擔的責任。)
New buildings must conform to strict rules about insulation and fire safety. (新建築必須符合隔熱和消防安全的嚴格規定。)

meaning: adj. 方便的；手邊的；手巧的
example: A small torch is handy when the power fails during a winter storm. (冬天暴風雨停電時，一支小手電筒就很方便。)
The airline will notify passengers by text if the flight is cancelled. (如果班機取消，航空公司會以簡訊通知乘客。)
The view from the lighthouse is splendid at sunset, especially in autumn. (日落時從燈塔望出去的景色很壯麗，秋天尤其如此。)

meaning: n. 方向；指導；用法說明
example: Read the direction on the packet before you apply the chemical to the plants. (在把藥劑用在植物上之前，請先閱讀包裝上的用法說明。)
The team executed the plan so carefully that nobody noticed the change. (團隊執行這項計畫非常仔細，沒有人察覺到變動。)

meaning: n. 目擊者；證人 v. 目擊；見證
example: A witness described the lorry as it turned into the narrow street. (一名目擊者描述了那輛卡車轉進窄街時的情況。)

meaning: n. 手肘；彎頭 v. 用肘推
example: He injured his elbow while lifting heavy boxes at the warehouse last week. (他上週在倉庫搬重箱子時傷到了手肘。)
Parking near the hospital is limited, so staff are encouraged to cycle. (醫院附近的停車位有限，因此鼓勵員工騎自行車。)
A fishing vessel rescued the two sailors after their boat struck a rock. (一艘漁船在他們的船撞上岩石後，救起兩名船員。)

meaning: adj. 私人的；私下的；私立的
example: Private gardens are now open to the public once a year in this town. (在這座小鎮，私人花園每年開放一次供民眾參觀。)

meaning: adj. 立體聲的 n. 立體聲音響
example: He still keeps an old stereo that once belonged to his father. (他還留著一台曾經屬於他父親的舊立體聲音響。)
Soak the beans overnight, or they will take several hours to cook. (豆子要浸泡一夜，否則要煮好幾個小時。)

meaning: adj. 肥胖的；結實的；頑強的
example: A stout wooden door kept the wind out of the old farmhouse. (一扇結實的木門，擋住了吹進老農舍的風。)
The kitchen floor gets greasy quickly when the fryers are used all day. (油炸鍋整天使用時，廚房地板很快就變得油膩。)
The brochure boasts that the hotel has the best view in town. (這本簡介誇稱這家飯店有全鎮最好的景觀。)
The council took swift action to close the bridge after cracks appeared. (橋面出現裂縫後，市議會迅速採取行動封閉橋樑。)
Public ignorance about recycling is one reason so much plastic is thrown away. (大眾對回收的無知，是大量塑膠被丟棄的原因之一。)
The changes were made for aesthetic reasons rather than to improve safety. (這些改動是基於美學考量，而不是為了提升安全。)

meaning: n. 螢幕；屏風 vt. 篩選；遮蔽；放映
example: Every applicant is screened before being offered a place on the programme. (每位申請者在獲得計畫名額前，都會先經過篩選。)

meaning: adj. 缺席的；心不在焉的
example: Two members were absent from the meeting, so the vote was postponed. (有兩名成員缺席會議，因此表決延後。)

meaning: v. 刮；擦 n. 擦傷
example: He scraped the ice off the windscreen with an old plastic card. (他用一張舊塑膠卡把擋風玻璃上的冰刮掉。)
A two-for-one promotion brought many new customers into the small village bookshop. (買一送一的促銷，為這家小書店帶來許多新客人。)
The lake is used for recreation, and fishing is allowed in certain areas. (這座湖供休閒使用，部分區域允許釣魚。)
The clinic specialises in treating older patients with common long-term health conditions. (這間診所專精於治療有慢性病的年長病患。)
The magnificent ceiling of the station was restored using photographs from 1900. (車站宏偉的天花板，是依 1900 年的照片修復的。)
Spasmodic bursts of heavy rain made the harvest very unpredictable this year. (一陣陣間歇的豪雨，讓今年的收成難以預測。)

meaning: n. 基金；資金 vt. 資助
example: The city funded free bus travel for pensioners on weekday mornings last year. (這座城市去年資助長者在平日上午免費搭公車。)
Many drivers still perceive cycling as dangerous, even on quiet side streets. (許多駕駛人認為騎自行車很危險，即使在安靜的巷道上也一樣。)
The manufacturer recalled the lamps after several customers reported smoke from them. (在幾位顧客反映燈具冒煙後，製造商召回這批燈。)
The tiles were rejected because they did not match the agreed specification. (這批磁磚因為不符合議定的規格而被退回。)

meaning: n. 時刻表；日程 v. 安排
example: The bus schedule changes in winter, when fewer people travel to the coast. (公車時刻表在冬天會調整，因為去海岸的人較少。)
The seating arrangement was changed so that quieter guests could sit together. (座位安排做了調整，讓較安靜的客人可以坐在一起。)
The destruction of the mangrove forest left the coast exposed to storms. (紅樹林的破壞，使海岸失去抵擋暴風雨的屏障。)
A fire extinguisher must be checked every year and kept near the door. (滅火器每年都必須檢查，並放在門邊。)
I assume the parcel will arrive on Thursday, since the shop posted it on Monday. (我假設包裹會在星期四到，因為店家星期一就寄出了。)
A large proportion of the village now works in the city and comes home only at weekends. (村裡很大一部分的人現在都在城裡工作，只有週末才回家。)
He walked forth into the cold morning without saying goodbye to anyone. (他走進寒冷的早晨，沒有跟任何人道別。)

meaning: n. 裁判；仲裁人 v. 裁判
example: The referee stopped the match twice because the pitch was too wet to play on. (裁判兩次暫停比賽，因為場地太濕，無法繼續踢球。)
She decided to forgo dessert so that she could catch the earlier train. (她決定不吃甜點，好趕上比較早的那班火車。)

meaning: n. 研究生助教獎學金
example: His assistantship pays the tuition and a small monthly amount for living costs. (他的助教獎學金支付學費，另外每月還有少許生活費。)
Their conversation on the train lasted the whole journey from Taipei to Hualien. (他們在火車上的談話，從台北一路聊到花蓮。)
The hotel was full, so the clerk wrote a recommendation for a guesthouse nearby. (飯店客滿，櫃檯人員便寫了一封推薦信，介紹附近的民宿。)
The graph shows how electricity use rises sharply on the hottest days of summer. (這張圖表顯示，夏季最熱的幾天用電量會急遽上升。)
The company planted trees to offset the carbon produced by its delivery vans. (公司種樹來抵消貨車排放的碳。)

meaning: n. 人類；人性；人文學科
example: Climate change is often described as the greatest challenge facing humanity this century. (氣候變遷常被形容為本世紀人類面臨的最大挑戰。)

meaning: adj. 完整無缺的；完好無損的
example: The old temple survived the earthquake, and its painted ceiling is still intact. (這座老廟挺過了地震，彩繪天花板依然完整無缺。)
A yellow stripe runs along the edge of the platform to warn passengers. (月台邊緣有一條黃色條紋，用來提醒乘客。)
The mechanical noise from the old pump kept the whole family awake. (老抽水機發出的機械聲，讓全家人都睡不著。)
Turn left at the junction where the bakery stands, and you will see the park. (在麵包店所在的交叉口左轉，就會看到公園。)
In many hot countries, shops close at noon so that staff can take a siesta. (在許多炎熱的國家，商店中午會休息，讓員工睡個午覺。)
Dogs can detect tiny amounts of smoke long before people notice the smell. (在人們聞到煙味之前，狗就能察覺到極少量的煙。)

meaning: n. 繞道；便道 v. 繞道
example: Road works forced us to take a long detour through the hills. (道路施工迫使我們繞道，穿過山區走了一大段遠路。)
The narrow staircase at the back of the house leads to a small attic. (屋子後方的窄樓梯通往一間小閣樓。)
Her arthritis gets worse in cold, wet weather, so she moved to a warmer town. (她的關節炎在溼冷的天氣會更嚴重，所以她搬到了比較溫暖的城鎮。)
Language was the biggest barrier when he first arrived in a small farming town. (他初到這座小農村時，語言是最大的障礙。)
The council plans to replace the old street lights with brighter, cheaper ones. (市公所打算用更亮、更省電的燈替換舊路燈。)
The families waited twenty years for justice after the factory poisoned their river. (工廠毒害他們的河川後，這些家庭等了二十年才等到正義。)
He framed his diploma and hung it above the desk in his first office. (他把畢業文憑裱框，掛在第一次租的辦公室書桌上方。)
Her visa allows her to stay for six months, but she cannot work here. (她的簽證允許她停留六個月，但不能在這裡工作。)
The lecture covered cosmic dust, the fine material that forms clouds between stars. (那場講座談到宇宙塵，也就是在恆星之間形成雲的細微物質。)

meaning: adj. 可延伸的；可擴展的
example: The table is extendable, so it seats eight when guests come for dinner. (這張桌子可以延伸，有客人來吃晚餐時能坐八個人。)
There was an abundance of fresh fruit at the market that weekend. (那個週末市場上有大量新鮮水果。)
The supervisor on the night shift checks every machine before the plant closes. (夜班主管會在工廠關門前檢查每一部機器。)

meaning: n. 混雜；舊雜貨 vt. 混雜
example: The drawer was a jumble of old receipts, batteries and broken pens. (抽屜裡是一堆混雜的舊收據、電池和壞掉的筆。)
The school will equip every classroom with a projector and a new whiteboard. (學校將為每間教室配備投影機和新的白板。)
After three years of temporary contracts, she finally got a permanent job. (做了三年約聘工作後，她終於得到一份永久的職位。)
Small stones were embedded in the mud, making the path painful to walk. (小石頭嵌在泥巴裡，走這條路很痛。)
New staff spend their first morning at an orientation session about safety rules. (新進員工第一個上午要參加迎新說明會，內容是安全規則。)
The dam deprived the village of water during the driest months of the year. (水壩讓這個村莊在最乾的幾個月裡失去水源。)
It amazed me that the tiny shop sold bread from six in the morning. (令我驚訝的是，那家小店從早上六點就開始賣麵包。)
The company paid a small dividend to shareholders even in a bad year. (即使在那樣不景氣的一年，公司仍發給股東一點股息。)
Given the choice, most passengers showed a clear preference for the window seats. (若有選擇，多數乘客明顯偏好靠窗的座位。)

meaning: n. 契約；合約 v. 縮小；簽約
example: Read the contract carefully before you sign anything, especially the last page. (簽任何文件之前都要仔細讀合約，尤其是最後一頁。)
She felt uneasy walking home alone after the street lights went out. (路燈熄掉後，她一個人走回家，心裡很不安。)
The door locks automatically at midnight, so remember to take your key. (這扇門午夜會自動上鎖，所以記得帶鑰匙。)

meaning: adj. 女性的；雌性的 n. 女性；雌性
example: The female engineers on the team designed a lighter frame for the bike. (團隊中的女性工程師設計了更輕的自行車車架。)
Her calm manner is a great asset when customers start to complain. (客人開始抱怨時，她沉穩的態度是一大優勢。)
The young athlete trains twice a day and still finds time to study. (這位年輕運動員每天練兩次，還能抽出時間讀書。)
For clarity, the map uses different colours for each type of road. (為了清楚起見，地圖用不同顏色標示各類道路。)
We can swap seats if you prefer to sit next to the window. (如果你想坐靠窗的位置，我們可以交換座位。)

meaning: adj. 老練的；精密的；複雜的
example: The new camera is sophisticated, but the menu is hard to understand. (這台新相機很精密，但選單很難看懂。)
The bulk of the harvest is sold to shops in the nearest city. (收成的大部分都賣給最近城市的店家。)
Heavy machinery was brought in to clear the fallen trees after the storm. (暴風雨過後，重型機械被調來清運倒下的樹木。)

meaning: adj. 親密的；私人的 n. 密友 vt. 暗示
example: Only a few intimate friends were invited to the small wedding ceremony. (婚禮辦得很小，只邀請了幾位親密的朋友。)
The city restricts cars in the old quarter on Sundays to reduce pollution. (為了減少污染，市政府星期日限制車輛進入舊城區。)
The dress was too tight around the waist, so she had it altered. (這件洋裝腰部太緊，所以她拿去改。)
The team lacked a player of his calibre, and the season ended badly. (隊上少了像他這種才幹的球員，球季最後成績很差。)

meaning: adj. 嚴厲的；惡劣的；刺耳的
example: The winter here is harsh, with strong winds and very little sunlight. (這裡的冬天很惡劣，風大又幾乎沒有陽光。)
Parliament debated the new tax for three days before putting it to a vote. (國會針對新稅辯論了三天，才付諸表決。)
Our flight to Hong Kong was delayed for two hours because of heavy fog. (我們飛往香港的班機因為濃霧延誤了兩小時。)
Please remind me to water the plants while I am away next week. (下週我不在的時候，請提醒我澆花。)
The aquarium has a tunnel where visitors can walk under the sharks. (水族館有一條隧道，遊客可以從鯊魚下方走過。)
Each cell in the body needs oxygen, which the blood carries from the lungs. (身體每個細胞都需要氧氣，由血液從肺部運送過來。)
Many city dwellers escape to the mountains for a quiet weekend in autumn. (許多城市居民會在秋天逃到山上，圖個安靜的週末。)
The mayor declared the old riverside market a protected site last spring. (市長去年春天宣布舊河岸市場為保護區。)
My suitcase was so heavy that I had to pay an extra fee. (我的手提箱太重了，只好付額外費用。)

meaning: n. 畢業生 v. 畢業
example: Every graduate of the course receives a certificate and a list of contacts. (這門課的每位畢業生都會拿到證書和一份聯絡名單。)
Scientists still cannot predict exactly when the volcano will next erupt again. (科學家仍無法準確預測這座火山下次何時爆發。)
The company moved its headquarters to a smaller town to cut costs. (公司把總部搬到比較小的城鎮以降低成本。)
The flood received little national coverage because another disaster filled the news. (那場水災報導很少，因為另一場災難佔滿了新聞版面。)
Officers enforce the parking rules strictly during the busy morning rush hour. (早上尖峰時段，員警嚴格執行停車規定。)
Dried persimmon is a local specialty that sells well in winter markets. (柿餅是本地特產，冬天在市場賣得很好。)
The stone has no intrinsic value, but the family keeps it as a memory. (這塊石頭沒有固有的價值，但家人把它當作紀念留著。)
Medical supplies finally reached the mountain village two days after the landslide. (山崩過後兩天，醫療物資終於送達山區村落。)
Stick the label on the box before you take it to the post office. (把標籤貼在箱子上，再拿到郵局寄。)
The plan sounds realistic, but it depends on money we do not have. (這個計畫聽起來很實際，但要靠我們沒有的經費才行。)

meaning: adj. 漠不關心的；無關緊要的
example: He seemed indifferent to the result, though he had trained for months. (他似乎對結果漠不關心，儘管已經訓練了好幾個月。)
The retailer agreed to take back the faulty kettle and give a refund. (零售商同意收回故障的水壺並退款。)
The shop's turnover doubled after it started selling coffee in the mornings. (早上開始賣咖啡之後，這家店的營業額成長了一倍。)

meaning: n. 品牌；商標 vt. 打烙印
example: This brand of tea is popular because it is cheap and easy to find. (這個品牌的茶很受歡迎，因為便宜又容易買到。)
Children under ten must be accompanied by an adult in the pool area. (十歲以下兒童在泳池區必須由成人陪同。)

meaning: v. 欺騙；作弊 n. 騙子
example: Some customers cheat by swapping the price tags on goods, which costs shops money. (有些客人會調換商品上的價標來佔便宜，讓店家吃虧。)
She did not mention the broken window when the landlord called last night. (房東打電話來時，她沒有提到破掉的窗戶。)

meaning: n. 水平；等級 adj. 平的；同等的 v. 使平坦
example: The water level in the reservoir fell sharply during the long dry summer. (漫長乾燥的夏天裡，水庫的水位大幅下降。)
This plant grows lateral roots that spread just below the surface of the soil. (這種植物長出側根，在地表下方蔓延。)
The forest is so dense that sunlight barely reaches the forest floor. (森林太茂密，陽光幾乎照不到地面。)

meaning: v. 閃光；閃耀 n. 閃光燈
example: A sudden flash of lightning lit the whole valley for a second. (一道突如其來的閃電，把整個山谷照亮了一秒。)
We packed nuts and fruit as a snack for the long walk. (我們帶了堅果和水果，當作長途健行的點心。)
The view from the ridge was marvellous, though the climb was hard. (雖然爬得很辛苦，稜線上的風景卻美得沒話說。)

meaning: v. 出口；輸出 n. 出口；出口商品
example: The country exports tea and coffee to markets in Europe and Asia. (這個國家出口茶和咖啡到歐洲與亞洲市場。)
The concert was a tribute to the singer, who died last winter. (那場音樂會是向去年冬天過世的歌手致敬。)
The camp had no sanitary facilities, so illness spread through it quickly. (營地沒有衛生設備，疾病很快就蔓延開來。)
You must submit the form in person, not by email or post. (這份表格必須親自繳交，不能寄電子郵件或郵寄。)

meaning: n. 檔案；檔案室 vt. 存檔
example: The archive holds letters, maps and photographs from the last two centuries. (這座檔案館收藏了上個世紀的信件、地圖和照片。)
The evidence is only anecdotal, so we cannot draw a firm conclusion. (這些證據只是軼聞，無法據此得出確定的結論。)
He took notes in shorthand and typed them up after the meeting. (他用速記做筆記，會後再打成文字。)
Her memory for names is exceptional, even among people twice her age. (她記名字的能力異常出眾，連年紀是她兩倍的人也比不上。)
It is rude to answer your phone during a meal with guests. (和客人一起用餐時接電話，是很粗魯的行為。)
Work on the bridge will resume once the river drops to a safe level. (等河水降到安全水位，橋樑工程就會重新開始。)
A wooden bookrest kept the heavy dictionary open at the right page. (木製閱書架把厚重的字典撐開在正確的那一頁。)

meaning: adj. 原始的；簡單的 n. 原始人
example: The first farming tools were primitive, made from stone, bone and wood. (最早的農具很原始，是用石頭、骨頭和木頭做的。)
The village is known for the craft of weaving baskets from reeds. (這個村莊以用蘆葦編籃子的工藝聞名。)

meaning: v. 僱用；租用 n. 租用
example: We hired a car for three days to explore the coast at our own pace. (我們租了三天車，沿著海岸慢慢玩。)
She put on her goggles before jumping into the cold mountain lake. (她跳進冰冷的湖水前，先戴上了泳鏡。)
The new bus lane keeps cars out of the centre, thereby cutting journey times. (新的公車專用道讓汽車不能進入市中心，因此縮短了行車時間。)

meaning: n. 樁；股份；賭注 vt. 以……打賭
example: She sold her stake in the family business and moved abroad for good. (她賣掉家族企業的股份，搬到國外去了。)

meaning: n. 駁船 v. 猛撞；闖
example: A long barge carried sand slowly down the river towards the harbour. (一艘長長的駁船載著沙子，慢慢順流航向港口。)
She teaches aerobics at the community centre on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. (她每週二、週四晚上在活動中心教有氧運動。)
A low shrub near the gate hides the water meter from view. (大門旁的一叢低矮灌木把水表遮住了。)

meaning: n. 板條 vt. 用板條製作
example: One wooden slat on the bench was loose and pinched my leg. (長椅上一根木板條鬆了，夾到我的腿。)
The council took legal action against the factory over the polluted stream. (針對受污染的溪流，市公所對工廠採取法律行動。)
The film is worth seeing for its cinematography, especially the desert scenes. (這部片光是電影攝影就值得看，尤其是沙漠那幾場戲。)
Everyone in the village contributed wood and labour to rebuild the school. (村裡每個人都捐出木材和勞力，協助重建學校。)

meaning: n. 想像力；想像的事物
example: The story shows a young child's imagination at its richest and strangest. (這個故事展現了孩子最豐富、最奇特的想像力。)
His bronchitis returned every winter until he stopped working in the damp basement. (他每到冬天支氣管炎就復發，直到他辭掉那間潮溼地下室的工作。)
Cutting the trees exacerbated flooding downstream, as the soil could no longer hold water. (砍掉那些樹木使下游水患加劇，因為土壤再也留不住水。)
The fence was built to prevent the intrusion of wild pigs into the vegetable garden. (這道圍籬是為了防止野豬闖入菜園而建的。)
They had to cancel the picnic because the field was still flooded. (他們不得不取消野餐，因為場地還積著水。)

meaning: n. 軟木塞 vt. 塞住
example: He pulled the cork out slowly so that the wine would not spill. (他慢慢拔出軟木塞，免得酒灑出來。)
The data from the survey will be published on the council's website. (這份調查的資料會公布在市公所的網站上。)
A herd of buffalo crossed the road and stopped traffic for ten minutes. (一群水牛橫越馬路，讓交通中斷了十分鐘。)
There was insufficient evidence to prove who had started the fire in the barn. (沒有足夠證據證明是誰在穀倉放的火。)
The only grocery in the village closes at seven in the evening on weekdays. (村裡唯一的雜貨店平日七點關門。)
Summer here is humid, and clothes take several days to dry indoors. (這裡的夏天很潮溼，衣服掛在室內要好幾天才會乾。)
The relation between diet and heart disease has been studied for decades. (飲食與心臟病的關係已經被研究了好幾十年。)
Some tourists confuse this street with the one that leads to the station. (有些遊客會把這條街和通往車站的那條搞混。)
The museum keeps the correspondence between the two painters in a locked cabinet. (博物館把這兩位畫家往來的信件收在上了鎖的櫃子裡。)
The allocation of water to each farm is decided at the start of spring. (每座農場分到多少水，是在春天一開始就決定的。)
The town offers little entertainment for teenagers apart from a small cinema. (這座小鎮除了小電影院之外，幾乎沒有什麼給青少年的娛樂。)
It took him three attempts to conquer his fear of deep water. (他試了三次才克服對深水的恐懼。)
The decorations for the festival are made from bamboo and coloured paper. (節慶的裝飾品是用竹子和彩色紙做的。)

meaning: n. 獎賞；報酬 vt. 獎勵
example: A reward of five thousand dollars was offered for the missing dog. (有人懸賞五千元尋找那隻走失的狗。)
Each larva feeds on leaves for weeks before it becomes a beetle. (每隻幼蟲會吃好幾週的葉子，然後才變成甲蟲。)
She spent a semester in Japan and came back speaking better Japanese. (她在日本待了一個學期，回來時日文講得好多了。)
The pair raised four offspring, all of which stayed near the nest. (這對鳥養大了四隻後代，牠們都留在巢附近。)
Apart from occasional rain, the weather stayed dry for the whole trip. (除了偶爾下雨，整趟旅程天氣都很乾爽。)
The crater is now a lake, and visitors can walk around its rim. (那個火山口現在是一座湖，遊客可以沿著邊緣走一圈。)
When the power failed, confusion ensued and the concert started twenty minutes late. (停電之後現場一片混亂，音樂會因此晚了二十分鐘才開始。)
The guide instructed us to keep away from the edge of the cliff. (導遊指示我們不要靠近懸崖邊緣。)
The declaration was signed by both countries after months of quiet talks. (兩國經過數月會談後簽署了這份宣言。)
Working from home gives parents more flexibility over their daily family schedule. (在家工作讓父母在每天的家庭行程安排上更有彈性。)

meaning: adj. 本地的 n. 本地人
example: The garden is planted with native species that need very little watering. (這座花園種的是本地樹種，不太需要澆水。)
The report found a significant drop in the number of birds this year. (報告發現今年鳥類數量明顯減少。)
The small shop survives on the loyalty of customers who have known it for years. (這家小店靠著老顧客的忠誠撐了下來。)
After swimming, she washes her hair and uses conditioner to soften it. (游完泳後，她洗頭並用潤髮乳讓頭髮柔順。)
The factory promised to reduce the amount of waste it sends to landfill. (工廠承諾減少送到掩埋場的廢棄物數量。)
The new road caused controversy because it cuts through a protected wetland. (這條新路引發爭議，因為它穿過一塊受保護的溼地。)

meaning: n. 服務；公共設施；維修 vt. 維修
example: The bus service to the village runs only twice a day in winter. (冬天到村莊的公車一天只有兩班。)
Very few animals can dwell in such a dry and salty environment. (很少有動物能在這麼乾又鹹的地方棲身。)
A burning sensation in his fingers made him drop the hot pan. (手指一陣灼熱的感覺，讓他鬆手把熱鍋掉了。)

meaning: n. 碎屑；廢料 vt. 廢棄
example: The shed was full of scrap metal left over from old machines. (棚子裡堆滿了舊機器留下來的廢金屬。)
She grew anxious when the ferry did not appear on time again. (渡輪沒有準時出現，她開始焦慮起來。)
The recipient must sign for the parcel before the driver hands it over. (收件人必須先簽收，司機才會把包裹交給他。)
The two houses look identical, and even the owners sometimes mix them up. (這兩棟房子看起來完全一樣，連屋主有時也會搞錯。)
The pots are made of local clay and dried in the sun. (這些陶壺用本地黏土做成，放在太陽下曬乾。)

meaning: n. 競爭者；對手 vt. 與……匹敵
example: The two cafes are rivals, yet their owners borrow sugar from each other. (這兩家咖啡店是競爭對手，但老闆們還是會互相借糖。)
Tropospheric ozone near the ground harms crops and irritates the human lungs. (靠近地面的對流層臭氧會傷害農作物，也會刺激肺部。)
The old lighthouse is the main attraction for visitors to this coast. (這座老燈塔是這片海岸最吸引遊客的景點。)
The earthwork around the fort is still clearly visible from the air. (堡壘周圍的土方工程從空中還清楚可見。)
Tall reeds surround the whole pond, hiding it completely from the road. (高高的蘆葦圍繞著池塘，讓它完全從路上看不到。)
My first impression of the town was of too many cars and too few trees. (我對這座城鎮的第一印象是車太多、樹太少。)
The state of the kitchen horrified her, so she cleaned it for two hours. (廚房的狀況讓她很震驚，於是她花了兩小時打掃。)
The introduction explains why the study focuses mainly on small coastal towns. (導言說明了這份研究為何主要聚焦在小型沿海城鎮。)

meaning: adj. 緊密的；簡明的 vt. 壓縮
example: His report is compact and easy to read, with no wasted words. (他的報告簡明易讀，沒有多餘的字。)
She phoned the office to enquire about the opening hours of the pool. (她打電話到辦公室，詢問游泳池的開放時間。)
From June onwards, the market will open an hour earlier every Saturday. (從六月起，市場每個星期六都會提早一小時開門。)
A short memorandum was sent to all staff about the new security code. (一份簡短的備忘錄發給所有員工，說明新的門禁密碼。)
The garden is rectangular, with a path running straight down the middle. (這座花園是長方形的，中間有一條筆直的小路。)
He needs to drink more water because his kidneys are not working well. (他需要多喝水，因為他的腎臟功能不好。)
From a health standpoint, fried food should not be eaten every day. (從健康的觀點來看，油炸食物不該天天吃。)

meaning: adj. 有療效的 n. 藥品
example: The spring water was once believed to have curative powers for skin diseases. (這處泉水曾被認為對皮膚病有療效。)
The audience was predominantly young, though a few older couples sat at the back. (觀眾大多是年輕人，不過後面也坐了幾個年長的夫妻。)

meaning: n. 離合器 v. 抓緊
example: The clutch on the old truck slips whenever the road goes uphill. (這輛老卡車的離合器在上坡時會打滑。)
The recipe combines sour cream with dill and a little lemon juice. (這道食譜把酸奶油、蒔蘿和一點檸檬汁結合在一起。)

meaning: n. 圖表；海圖 vt. 記錄
example: The chart on the wall shows the tides for the whole month. (牆上的圖表標出整個月的潮汐。)
Her asthma is worse in spring, when the pollen count is high. (她的氣喘在花粉多的春天比較嚴重。)
The bank will not accept the form without your signature at the bottom. (沒有你在底部的簽名，銀行不會接受這份表格。)

meaning: n. 場合；時機 vt. 引起
example: The wedding was the only occasion last year when the whole family met. (那場婚禮是去年全家人唯一聚在一起的場合。)
This water contains natural minerals that give it a slightly salty taste. (這種水含有礦物質，喝起來有一點鹹味。)
Her knowledge of the old land records was invaluable during the long search. (漫長的搜尋過程中，她對舊土地紀錄的了解非常珍貴。)
It took him a month to recover from the operation on his knee. (他膝蓋開刀後花了一個月才恢復。)
The doctor advised moderation in coffee and said sleep mattered far more. (醫生建議咖啡要適量，並說睡眠重要得多。)
Bring all the documentation with you, including the receipt and the guarantee. (請把所有文件都帶來，包括收據和保證書。)

meaning: adj. 批判的；危急的；關鍵的
example: Timing is critical when you plant these seeds before the rain comes. (在雨來之前播下這些種子，時機很關鍵。)
He took a vocational course in welding and found work within a month. (他上了焊接的職業課程，一個月內就找到工作。)

meaning: n. 摘要 adj. 概括的
example: At the end of the report there is a one-page summary of the findings. (報告最後有一頁的研究結果摘要。)
Workers used a crane to remove the fallen sign from the road. (工人用吊車把倒在路上的招牌移走。)
The old coffer in the corner held documents nobody had opened for years. (角落那個舊保險箱裡的文件，已經好幾年沒人打開過。)
Given the icy roads, some delays are bound to happen this evening. (路面結冰，今晚一定會有延誤。)
Old thermometers contain mercury, so they must not be thrown in the bin. (舊溫度計含有水銀，所以不能丟進垃圾桶。)

meaning: n. 小飾品；不值錢的珠寶
example: She keeps a box of trinkets from places she visited as a child. (她留著一盒小時候旅行各地買的小飾品。)
My passport expires next March, so I should renew it before the trip. (我的護照明年三月到期，所以我應該在旅行前換新。)

meaning: adj. 可接近的；易到達的
example: The beach is accessible by a narrow wooden path suitable for wheelchairs. (這片海灘有一條適合輪椅的窄木棧道可以到達。)
Each turbine stands about a hundred metres tall and turns slowly in the wind. (每座渦輪機大約一百公尺高，在風中緩緩轉動。)
Small family farms form the backbone of the local economy in this valley. (小型家族農場是這個山谷地方經濟的骨幹。)

meaning: vt. 歸因於 n. 屬性
example: She attributes her good health to daily walking and a simple diet. (她把自己的健康歸因於走路和簡單的飲食。)
No one expected a sudden storm of this magnitude in early autumn. (沒有人料到初秋會有這麼大的暴風雨。)
This charger is not compatible with the older model of the phone. (這個充電器跟舊款手機不相容。)
The young entrepreneur started out by selling cakes from her own kitchen. (這位年輕創業者最初在自己廚房裡賣蛋糕。)
The proposal for a new car park was rejected at the public meeting. (新停車場的提案在公開會議上被否決了。)

meaning: n. 教練；長途巴士 vt. 訓練
example: We took a coach to the coast because the train was fully booked. (因為火車客滿，我們改搭長途巴士去海邊。)
A single mistake on that narrow mountain path can easily prove fatal. (在那條狹窄山徑上，一個失誤就可能致命。)
The local currency lost value quickly, so prices changed almost every week. (當地貨幣迅速貶值，物價幾乎每週都在變。)
Her parents disapprove of the plan to travel alone for a year. (她父母不贊成她獨自旅行一年的計畫。)
Several neighbours complained about the noise from the workshop late at night. (好幾位鄰居抱怨工廠深夜發出的噪音。)
The fact sheet lists the opening times, ticket prices and bus routes. (這份資料頁列出開放時間、票價和公車路線。)
It was an audacious plan, and few people expected it to work. (那是個大膽的計畫，很少人認為它會成功。)
Heavy snow disrupted train services across the north for almost three days. (大雪讓北部火車班次中斷了將近三天。)

meaning: v. 跋涉 n. 長途跋涉；流浪漢
example: We tramped through wet fields for hours before finally reaching the farm. (我們在溼透的田野裡走了好幾個小時，才終於到農場。)
Aphids are a common pest on roses and spread quickly in warm weather. (蚜蟲是玫瑰常見的害蟲，天氣暖和時蔓延得很快。)
Inflation rose sharply last year, and everyday food became much more expensive. (去年通貨膨脹大幅上升，日常食物貴了許多。)
The company issued a short statement denying that it had moved jobs abroad. (公司發表簡短聲明，否認把工作機會移到國外。)

meaning: n. 總額；數量 vi. 合計
example: A small amount of salt brings out the sweetness of the tomatoes. (少量的鹽能帶出番茄的甜味。)
Under the given conditions, the seeds will sprout within about ten days. (在特定條件下，這些種子大約十天內就會發芽。)
The hospital bought advanced equipment for scanning the brain in fine detail. (醫院採購了先進設備，能詳細掃描腦部。)
Learning to swim was a milestone for the shy eight-year-old village boy. (學會游泳對這個害羞的八歲鄉下男孩是個里程碑。)

meaning: n. 曲柄 vt. 轉動曲柄
example: He turned the crank slowly until the old engine coughed into life. (他慢慢轉動曲柄，直到老引擎咳嗽似地發動起來。)
The lexicographer spent ten years collecting old local words used by fishermen. (這位詞典編纂者花了十年，收集漁民使用的古老在地詞彙。)

meaning: n. 束；串；群 v. 聚集
example: She bought a bunch of parsley and two lemons at the stall. (她在攤子上買了一把巴西里和兩顆檸檬。)
The dancers wore bright red costumes made of silk and tiny mirrors. (舞者穿著用絲綢和小鏡片做成的鮮豔紅色戲服。)

meaning: v. 驚嚇；害怕 n. 恐慌
example: The sudden noise scared the horses, and one of them bolted away. (突然的聲響嚇到馬匹，其中一匹還跑掉了。)
He manipulated the sales figures to make the loss look much smaller. (他操縱銷售數字，讓虧損看起來小得多。)

meaning: adj. 少年的；幼稚的 n. 少年
example: The centre runs classes for juvenile offenders who are learning a trade. (這個中心為正在學一技之長的少年犯開課。)
Scientists still argue about what causes this rare and strange weather phenomenon. (科學家仍在爭論這種罕見又奇怪的天氣現象是怎麼造成的。)

meaning: n. 貨物；貨運 vt. 運送
example: The railway carries freight at night, when passenger trains are much fewer. (這條鐵路在夜間運貨，因為那時客運列車少得多。)
Young plants are vulnerable to frost, so cover them well before midnight. (幼苗很容易受霜害，所以午夜前要把它們蓋好。)

meaning: n. 蒸汽 v. 冒蒸汽；以蒸汽驅動
example: White steam rose from the manhole and filled the whole narrow street. (白色蒸氣從人孔蓋冒出，瀰漫了整條窄街。)

meaning: adj. 貴重的；有價值的 n. 貴重物品
example: The old letters turned out to be valuable, and a museum bought them. (那些舊信件結果很值錢，被一家博物館買走了。)
Presumably the shop closed early because of the storm, but nobody knows. (店家大概是因為暴風雨提早關門，但沒有人確定。)

meaning: n. 聖地；庇護所；保護區
example: The island is a sanctuary for seabirds, and visitors must keep to the path. (這座島是海鳥的保護區，遊客必須走在步道上。)
The small press will bring out her second novel early next spring. (這家小出版社將在明年春初出版她的第二本小說。)
He is good at arithmetic but struggles to explain how he got the answer. (他算術很好，卻很難說清楚答案是怎麼來的。)
The library refused his request to keep the book for another month. (圖書館拒絕了他再借一個月的請求。)

meaning: v. 猛衝 n. 猛衝；破折號
example: She dashed across the road as the rain started to fall harder. (雨開始下大時，她衝過馬路。)
The new treatment takes six weeks and is not yet available everywhere. (新的療程要六週，而且還不是每個地方都有。)
The coarse cloth scratched his skin until he had washed it twice. (這塊粗布刺得他皮膚發癢，直到他洗了兩次。)

meaning: adj. 不安全的；缺乏自信的
example: He felt insecure among colleagues who had all studied at famous universities. (在那些名校出身的同事之間，他感到很沒自信。)
The table was covered with a white linen cloth for the wedding. (婚禮時桌上鋪著白色亞麻桌布。)
Her designs take their inspiration from the shapes of leaves and shells. (她的設計從葉片和貝殼的形狀取得靈感。)
A generous neighbour lent us her family car for the whole weekend. (一位慷慨的鄰居把家裡的車借我們用整個週末。)
Farmers here cultivate rice on very narrow stone terraces built centuries ago. (這裡的農民在數百年前砌成的狹窄石梯田上種稻。)

meaning: n. 活動；戰役 vi. 從事活動
example: The campaign to save the old cinema raised enough money in a month. (搶救老電影院的活動在一個月內募到足夠的錢。)
A rare sleep disorder keeps him awake for days at a time. (一種罕見的睡眠失調症讓他一次好幾天睡不著。)

meaning: vt. 發現；認出 n. 地點；斑點
example: From the hill we spotted a herd of deer near the river. (從山上我們發現河邊有一群鹿。)
Nobody could predict the outcome of the vote until the last minute. (直到最後一刻，沒有人能預測表決結果。)
Walking on the injured ankle aggravated the swelling, so he stopped at once. (用受傷的腳踝走路使腫脹加重，所以他立刻停下來。)
The whole scheme was built on deception, and it collapsed within a year. (整個計畫建立在欺騙之上，一年內就瓦解了。)
He sharpened the knife on a stone before cutting the warm bread. (他切溫熱的麵包前，先在石頭上把刀磨利。)
Her advice was very practical, and we followed it that same afternoon. (她的建議很實際，我們當天下午就照著做了。)
The leather is pliable enough to shape around the frame without cracking. (這塊皮革夠柔軟，可以包住框架而不裂開。)
The safe disposal of old batteries is a problem for small towns. (舊電池的安全處理對小鎮來說是個問題。)

meaning: n. 子公司 adj. 次要的；附屬的
example: The bank closed its local subsidiary and moved the staff to Taipei. (銀行關掉本地子公司，把員工調到台北。)
Be cautious with that ladder, because its left leg is slightly bent. (用那個梯子要小心，因為左邊的腳稍微彎了。)

meaning: n. 模式；樣式 vt. 使形成
example: The tiles form a pattern of blue stars on a white background. (磁磚在白底上排成藍色星星的樣式。)
The terrain is steep and rocky, so the walk takes longer than expected. (地形陡峭又多岩石，所以這段路走起來比預期久。)
He developed the photographs in a small darkroom behind the camera shop. (他在相機店後面的小暗房裡沖洗照片。)
She had to kneel to reach the jars at the back of the shelf. (她得跪下來才搆得到層架後面的玻璃罐。)
The amount of paperwork nearly overwhelmed him during his first week at work. (上班第一週，堆積如山的文件幾乎讓他不知所措。)
She looked at the broken fence with quiet contempt and said nothing. (她靜靜地輕蔑看著破掉的圍籬，什麼也沒說。)
I hardly recognized the square after they removed all the old trees. (他們把老樹全移走後，我幾乎認不出這個廣場。)
A small badge on his jacket showed that he worked at the local factory. (他外套上的小徽章顯示他在本地工廠工作。)
The town suffered badly during the economic downturn of the late nineties. (這座小鎮在九〇年代後期的經濟衰退中受創很深。)
The old lamp gave a feeble light, barely enough to read by. (那盞舊燈發出微弱的光，幾乎不夠看書。)
Patience is a virtue when you are learning to play an instrument. (學樂器時，耐心是一種美德。)
Beans are a good source of fibre and are cheap to cook. (豆類是很好的纖維來源，煮起來也便宜。)
They moved to a quiet suburb where the children could play outside. (他們搬到安靜的郊區，孩子可以在戶外玩。)
The machine pulverises the rocks into fine dust within a few minutes. (這台機器幾分鐘內就把石頭碾成細粉。)
Inductive reasoning moves from many small observations to a single general rule. (歸納推理是從許多細微觀察導向單一通則。)
Farmers fertilise the fields in early spring, before the first heavy rain. (農民在早春第一次大雨前施肥。)

meaning: n. 配給量；口糧 vt. 配給
example: During the drought, each household received a daily ration of clean water. (乾旱期間，每戶人家每天配到一份定量的乾淨用水。)
He worked two jobs for years to pay off the debt from the farm. (他做兩份工作好幾年，才還清農場留下的債務。)
The old house is attractive, but its roof needs urgent repairs soon. (這棟老房子很吸引人，但屋頂急需整修。)
The museum tells the story of the long conquest of the valley. (博物館講述這座山谷被長期征服的故事。)
As a sophisticate, she found the small town charming but rather slow. (她向來老練世故，覺得這座小鎮可愛，但步調太慢。)

meaning: v. 折斷；啪地關上；厲聲說 adj. 突然的
example: The branch snapped under his weight, and he fell into the bush. (樹枝在他體重下折斷，他摔進灌木叢裡。)

meaning: vt. 表達 adj. 特快的 n. 快車；快遞
example: She expressed her thanks with a short note and a box of cakes. (她寫了一張短箋、送了一盒蛋糕表達謝意。)
The bird is easily identifiable by the white patch above its beak. (這隻鳥可以靠喙上方的白斑輕易辨認出來。)

meaning: adj. 名義上的；微不足道的
example: He charges a nominal fee to cover the cost of the paper. (他只收一點象徵性的費用，貼補紙張成本。)
The gallery acquired the painting in 1975 and has shown it ever since. (美術館在一九七五年取得這幅畫，之後一直展出。)
I bumped into an old classmate at the night market last Friday. (上週五我在夜市巧遇一位老同學。)
Graphology claims to reveal character through handwriting, but the evidence is very weak. (筆跡學聲稱能從字跡看出性格，但證據非常薄弱。)

meaning: v. 登記；註冊 n. 登記表
example: You must register the bicycle before you can take it on the ferry. (你必須先登記自行車，才能把它帶上渡輪。)
The path was extremely narrow, and we had to walk single file. (這條路非常窄，我們只能排成一列走。)

meaning: v. 腐爛 n. 腐爛
example: The fruit began to rot after two days in the warm kitchen. (水果放在溫暖的廚房兩天後就開始腐爛。)
An ambulance arrived within ten minutes and took the injured cyclist to hospital. (救護車十分鐘內就到，把受傷的單車騎士送到醫院。)
The cold rain made the whole camping trip miserable for everyone there. (冰冷的雨讓在場每個人的整趟露營都很痛苦。)
A continuous low hum from the factory kept us awake all night. (工廠連續不斷的低鳴讓我們整夜睡不著。)

meaning: v. 分開；分配；除以 n. 分歧；分界線
example: A low wall divides the garden into two parts, each with its own gate. (一道矮牆把花園分成兩部分，各有自己的門。)
The film earned a gross income of ten million dollars in its first week. (這部片第一週的總收入達一千萬美元。)
Leave your wet coat in the cloakroom before you go upstairs to eat. (上樓用餐前，把溼外套放在衣帽間。)
The council offers short-term housing to families whose homes were badly flooded. (市公所提供短期住處給房子嚴重淹水的家庭。)
His refusal to answer the question made everyone at the table uneasy. (他拒絕回答問題，讓餐桌上的每個人都覺得不自在。)
She cut the coupon from the magazine and used it at the shop. (她從雜誌剪下優惠券，拿去店裡使用。)
He carried a heavy tome about local history to the reading room. (他帶著一本談本地歷史的厚重巨著到閱覽室。)
The shellfish can contain a toxin that causes numbness in the fingers. (這種貝類可能含有毒素，會讓手指發麻。)
The two fountains switch on simultaneously at seven every evening in summer. (夏天時，這兩座噴泉每天傍晚七點同時開啟。)
It seemed ridiculous to carry an umbrella on such a clear day. (這麼晴朗的天氣還帶傘，似乎很荒謬。)

meaning: n. 碎片；晶片 v. 削下碎片
example: A chip of stone flew up and hit the car's back window. (一塊碎石飛起來打中車子的後窗。)

meaning: v. 擦亮；潤飾 n. 亮光劑
example: He polished the brass handles until they shone in the afternoon light. (他把銅把手擦得在午後的陽光下發亮。)

meaning: v. 想知道；納悶 n. 驚奇；奇蹟
example: I wonder whether the bakery still opens at five in the morning. (我想知道那家麵包店是否還是清晨五點開門。)
The scholarship covers her tuition fees and most of her living costs. (這筆獎學金支付她的學費和大部分生活費。)
New volunteers spend a whole morning familiarising themselves with the safety rules. (新志工會花一整個上午熟悉安全規則。)
Life expectancy in the region has risen by almost ten years since 1990. (這個地區的平均壽命自一九九○年以來增加了將近十年。)
In the old market, a loaf of bread cost only a shilling. (在舊時的市場裡，一條麵包只要一先令。)
